blocks.text: 🪝 Taxation Bill 2026 Grants 15-Year Tax Exemption for Foreign Rough Diamond Trading via SNZs. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Unlocks global rough diamond trading hubs in Special Notified Zones (SNZs) by providing long-term tax certainty.
Inserts Entry 13F in Schedule IV of Income-tax Act 2025.
Tax Exemption Window: October 1, 2026 to March 31, 2041 (15-year tax holiday).
Rough diamond SNZ tax exemption (15 years: 2026–2041) vs Contract electronics capital goods tax exemption (sunset March 31, 2041).
